day1_night_start.text: *I put water on for noodles and take the transfer papers from my bag.*

day1_night_home_2.text: *On the back of the transfer papers, I write down the names I heard today.*

day1_night_home_3.text: *I think back to the classroom, library, infirmary, and council room, one after another. The smell of ramen fills the room.*

day1_night_phone_2.text: *The group chat from my old school. Beneath the message I sent this morning—'I transferred. How's everyone doing?'—there is a single gray check.*

day1_night_phone_3.text: *No one has read it. Read by 0.*

day1_night_phone_4.text: *I also messaged my close friend Minsu. 'Hey, Minsu. I transferred. This school is pretty big.' Still no reply.*

day1_night_phone_5.text: *I opened the message input box, then closed it. I had nothing to send.*

day1_night_phone_6.text: *Instead, there is a message from Sea.*

day1_night_sea_2.text: What do you want in your lunchbox tomorrow?

day1_night_sea_reply_2.text: Got it. Don't be surprised tomorrow.

day1_night_sleep_1.text: *I lie in bed and stare at the ceiling.*

day1_night_sleep_3.text: *I close my eyes. My head sinks into the pillow almost at once.*

day1_night_sleep_4.text: *Just before sleep takes me, I notice a stain on the ceiling: three short lines and a mark curving left.*

day1_night_sleep_5.text: *I blinked once, and it went back to a smeared stain. I closed my eyes.*

day1_night_key_1.text: *Half-asleep, I heard a short metallic sound from the front door. Click. Once.*

day1_night_key_2.text: *Was it a dream? I half-open my eyes. The room is dark, and the door is still closed.*

day1_night_key_3.text: *I checked the clock. 2:14 AM. The entryway sensor light turns on for the briefest moment, then goes out.*

day1_night_key_4.text: *I pull the covers closer and close my eyes again.*

day1_night_sleep_photo.text: *The photo Yuna gave me is on the desk.*

day1_night_sleep_tea.text: *The bag of tea sachets Nurse Riin gave me is on the desk.*

day1_night_sleep_milk.text: *The carton of milk Sea gave me is on the desk.*

day1_night_app_1.text: In a corner of the home screen was the provisional install icon I'd downloaded earlier through the QR code on the school gate leaflet. Beneath a blue shield, it read Hanul Safety App.

day1_night_app_2.text: The leaflet said basic notices and the timetable were available even before registering a student ID number.

day1_night_app_3.text: I opened Settings while still unregistered. Three collapsed items appeared, with little check marks already beside them.

day1_night_app_4.text: Real-time location. The school address was visible under the explanation that it was for safety reasons on the way to school.

day1_night_app_5.text: The second was microphone detection of sleep patterns. It was already checked before formal registration, so I tapped the description.

day1_night_app_6.text: The text about calculating the noise level within the device was long and went off the screen in the middle.

day1_night_app_7.text: Next to Heart Rate Sync, there was no device connected. It may be a function used during physical education class.

day1_night_app_8.text: I tried pushing the permission switch. The fingertips moved, but the gray circle remained in place.

day1_night_app_9.text: When the “Administrator Settings” sign appeared, I looked again at the life guidance section in the admissions notice.

day1_night_app_10.text: It said formal registration would be done tomorrow with my homeroom teacher. I could ask then.

day1_night_app_11.text: When I plugged in the charging cable, a speck of dust stuck to the terminal. I removed it with my fingernail and turned the screen back on.

day1_night_app_12.text: Tomorrow's timetable was posted below the app notice.
choices: Take a photo of your timetable

day1_night_app_13.text: Minsu's chat window, with no reply yet, was also the same. When I placed it side by side with the school app, the folder was full.

day1_night_app_14.text: While trying to check tomorrow's timetable, I couldn't close the settings window. My finger stopped on the gray switch.

day1_night_app_choice.text: I might ask tomorrow. Still, I wanted to press it at least once.
choices: Re-open the chat room sent to Minsu
Reduce screen brightness and cover it

day1_night_app_kill_1.text: When I pressed the end button, the screen turned off once. Seeing that the charging indicator is alive, it doesn't mean the power has gone out.

day1_night_app_kill_2.text: Entrusted education and life guidance standard protocol in operation. When the small notice disappeared, the shield icon reappeared.

day1_night_app_kill_3.text: An underlined line on the leaflet said administrator access could be disabled after registering at the staff room. I'd skimmed past it earlier.

day1_night_app_kill_4.text: If I messed with it and disrupted tomorrow's student card registration, that would be a hassle. I should ask my homeroom teacher first tomorrow.

day1_night_app_kill_5.text: I didn't want to create a reason for being late on the first day, so I captured the timetable and closed the settings.

day1_night_app_flash_aux.text: Entrusted education and life guidance standard protocol in operation

day1_night_app_minsu_1.text: The number 1 was still attached to the photo sent to Minsu. The last thing I sent was a photo of lunch.

day1_night_app_minsu_2.text: I clicked on profile. Instead of a face taken at the playground, a gray circle appeared for a long time.

day1_night_app_minsu_3.text: The basic silhouette that appeared in place of the photo was the same even if you went back and pressed it again.

day1_night_app_minsu_4.text: Because it is a mountain valley, the base station seems to be weak. The Wi-Fi sign has also just been reduced by one space.

day1_night_app_minsu_5.text: I wrote and deleted the sentence urging a reply. It was time for Minsu to use his cell phone at the academy.

day1_night_app_minsu_6.text: I just added good night and closed the chat window after confirming that the send button was displayed.

day1_night_app_dim_1.text: When I turned down the brightness, my forehead was reflected on the screen. The head that was depressed in the morning remained floating in the same direction until night.

day1_night_app_dim_2.text: I'll have to wash up a little early tomorrow. I checked the charging indicator and placed my phone face down next to the pillow.

day1_night_app_dim_3.text: I decided to erase the notification number on the shield icon in the morning. There were five names that I wrote down today.

day1_night_riin_msg_1.text: It vibrated and I turned my phone over to see the name tag of the health center on the school app messenger.

day1_night_riin_msg_2.text: Was the tea's scent all right today? It can seem a little strange the first time.

day1_night_riin_msg_3.text: I placed the cup I received during the day next to the sink. When I picked it up to wash it, there was a leaf left on the floor.

day1_night_riin_msg_4.text: You had a busy first day, learning names and finding classrooms. Have you had a chance to lie down?

day1_night_riin_msg_5.text: He said he was sitting on the bed and did not send a photo of the crumpled blanket. I lifted the screen a little closer.

day1_night_riin_msg_6.text: If you have trouble sleeping, drop by again at lunch tomorrow. You can pick your drink this time.

day1_night_riin_msg_7.text: Instead of a medical record, a teacup emoticon was added. I remembered the teacher's hands turning over the coasters during the day.

day1_night_riin_msg_8.text: I closed the window and washed the cup. After shaking off the moisture, I could see the cursor in the reply box again.

choices: Thanks to the tea, I got some rest. thank you
I say hello and put down my phone.

day1_night_riin_msg_thanks_1.text: You can bring the cup back tomorrow. No hurry. Good night.

day1_night_riin_msg_pick_1.text: All right. I'll still check anything strong, even if you pick it yourself.

day1_night_riin_msg_sleep_1.text: The screen went dark before the read receipt appeared. Only the light at the end of the charging cable remains.

day1_night_yuna_msg_1.text: A new contact appeared in the school messenger. A short message followed the name Choi Yuna from the photography club.

day1_night_yuna_msg_2.text: Don't go near the old building tonight. There are patrols after dark.

day1_night_yuna_msg_3.text: I looked at the time and it was already about time I went to bed. I guess I thought I was going to take pictures of the playground.

day1_night_yuna_msg_4.text: And don't lose that photo. Don't fold it up and shove it in your pocket, either.

day1_night_yuna_msg_5.text: I removed the paper from the desk and placed the photo between the notes, pushing the corners so they didn't stick out.

day1_night_yuna_msg_6.text: Ask the others for directions and they'll send you the wrong way for a laugh. Ask me during the day.

day1_night_yuna_msg_7.text: When I clicked on the small camera icon in the chat window, the introduction only listed the photography club activity times.

day1_night_yuna_msg_8.text: I was about to write a reply, but Yuna sent me a dot first and then deleted it. I also erased the first letter I wrote.

day1_night_yuna_msg_choice.text: I pressed the corner of the paper inserted into the notebook once more.
choices: I'll ask you tomorrow about the road.
Do you know when patrol ends?
Thanks for letting me know. good night

day1_night_yuna_msg_ask_1.text: Yeah. Just come to the photography club after lunch.

day1_night_yuna_msg_time_1.text: No idea. Just get some sleep tonight. I'm switching mine off too.

day1_night_yuna_msg_bye_1.text: Instead of Yuna's reply, a small moon emoticon came. I closed the notebook and turned off the stand.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_1.text: Before I could put my phone down, the school app notification popped up one more time. This time it was the name of my homeroom teacher.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_2.text: How was your first day? You did a lot of walking, finding your classroom.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_3.text: I looked where I had left my sneakers off. There was still a trace of a folded sock on the heel.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_4.text: More cherry blossoms will bloom tomorrow. When you go to school, look to the left of the entrance.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_5.text: As I passed the tree during the day, I said that there were fewer flowers in bloom, and the teacher remembered what I said.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_6.text: It’s okay to read app notices tomorrow. You don’t have to memorize everything from day one.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_7.text: When I deleted the reply while writing it, the typing indicator also turned off. There was no urging message from the teacher.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_8.text: Since I put my textbooks in the front compartment of my bag, I don't have to search my entire desk looking for books tomorrow.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_choice.text: I decided to say hello to the teacher and turn off my phone.
choices: Thanks to you, I was less lost. See you tomorrow
Can I ask about the safety app permissions tomorrow?
Yes, teacher, please rest well too.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_kind_1.text: Yes. If we meet in the hall tomorrow, you won't have to start by asking the way. Good night, {name}.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_app_1.text: Of course. We'll go through the instructions together. Just keep your phone charged for now.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_rest_1.text: A flower emoticon was added after the greeting. I set the alarm and turned over my phone.

day1_history_callback_1.text: The cup I received from the health room was still on the desk. After seeing the health check notification, I decided to wash the cup first.

day1_history_callback_2.text: It reminded me of the milk I put in the refrigerator. I tried to delete the notification before drinking and then put the phone down again.

day1_history_callback_3.text: I remembered Yuna holding a camera during the day. I thought I would find out about school app photo permissions by asking later.

day1_history_callback_4.text: I tried to write about the app I asked about earlier, but deleted it. The teacher didn't have to answer the same question twice.

day1_expansion_action_1_a.text: I saved the timetable and put it next to the alarm, so I could find my first class in the morning without having to open the app again.

day1_expansion_action_1_b.text: When I closed the notice window, the number of reads decreased by one. I put aside the items I didn't know yet and packed my bag.
